rows.measure: Private limited company: minimum share capital
rows.quote: The price of an individual share can be any value

rows.note: No minimum: the price of an individual share can be any value, and shareholders pay for their shares in full if the company shuts down.

rows.measure: Sole trader: wait before trading
rows.quote: You can start trading straight away without registering

source.title: Set up as a sole trader

rows.note: None: a sole trader can start trading straight away and registers for Self Assessment if earning more than GBP 1,000 in a tax year.

rows.note: Unlimited: the owner is personally responsible for all of the debts of the business.

rows.measure: Partnership: the partners' liability for the business's debts
rows.quote: personally share responsibility for your business

source.title: Set up a business partnership

rows.note: Shared and personal: the partners personally share responsibility for the business, its losses and its bills.

rows.quote: all partners are liable jointly and severally for all obligations of the partnership

rows.note: Unlimited, joint and several: all partners are liable for all obligations of the partnership unless the claimant agrees otherwise.
